If you can’t do 30% immediately, we’ll need an exec signal from your side on timing so we can consider temporary hold measures.

I’m looping in Kimberly and Marcus for an exec-level decision on accepting staged remit and entity routing, and Prio to own the payment cadence.

Thanks —
